part.text: {"program":[{"op":"reserve","slot":0},{"op":"read","slot":0,"src":0},{"op":"wait_reads"},{"op":"publish","slot":0},{"op":"acquire","slot":0},{"op":"write","slot":0,"dst":0},{"op":"write","slot":0,"dst":1},{"op":"write","slot":0,"dst":2},{"op":"write","slot":0,"dst":3},{"op":"wait_writes"},{"op":"release","slot":0}],"rationale":"Resubmission of the twice-accepted minimal protocol. With 1 input page and expected [0,0,0,0], one slot suffices. Barrier count 2 is forced: wait_reads must precede publish (publish requires initialized value, no pending read, and DMA completion order is arbitrary), and wait_writes must precede release (release requires no pending transfer). Command count 11 is minimal: reserve/read/publish/acquire/release are each mandated by the phase machine, exactly 4 writes are required for the 4 distinct destinations, and neither wait is elidable. Peak live slots 1. All completion orders safe: the four writes target distinct destinations so no pending-write conflict; multiple writes from one acquired slot are explicitly allowed; wait_reads/wait_writes are issued only after the transfers they drain are pending, so they cannot stall forever; outputs all carry origin src 0 matching expected. No FIFO or early-DMA assumption."}
